response: The VMPA (Vascularized Medial Pterygoid Aponeurosis) approach can provide direct access and favorable visibility to the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) region, yielding good esthetic and functional results. This approach can be considered the method of choice for common TMJ surgeries, potentially reducing complications and improving outcomes. By utilizing the VMPA, surgeons can achieve better access to the TMJ, which may lead to more effective and efficient treatment of various TMJ-related conditions.
